project.name: SM_BtechSyllabus - BWU
project.description: BTech 3rd semester lab report management system with admin dashboard, PDF splitting, and public module pages.

stack.auth: Custom session (jose JWT, PIN-based admin login)
stack.styling: Neumorphic dark UI, pure CSS (no framework)

features.name: Public module listing
features.description: Landing page shows all modules as neumorphic cards fetched from Supabase.

features.name: Weekly report cards
features.description: Each module page shows week cards with print/handwrite page chips, full PDF link, and DOCX dropdown.

features.name: Page chip viewer
features.description: Click any page chip to open the individual page PDF in a new tab.

features.name: Download Printing Pages (merged PDF)
features.description: Merges all print pages for a week into a single PDF via server-side API, triggers browser download with loading spinner. Filename format: Week{N}_{Title}_Printing.pdf.

features.name: DOCX dropdown
features.description: Per-week DOCX file access via dropdown menu with correct download filenames through proxy route.

features.name: Week date display
features.description: Read-only date chip on public cards showing when the lab was performed.

features.name: Admin login
features.description: PIN-based admin authentication via Supabase RPC (check_admin) with jose JWT session cookies.

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: Module tabs, week list with page badges, all management actions in restructured action-rows.

features.name: Upload & Auto-Split
features.description: Upload a weekly PDF directly to Cloudinary from the browser (bypasses Next.js body size limits), then server creates week record, saves metadata, downloads from Cloudinary, and splits into individual page PDFs.

features.name: Re-split Pages
features.description: Re-split existing week's full PDF. Clears old page files first (idempotent), then re-creates from full PDF.

features.name: DOCX upload/replace
features.description: Upload or replace DOCX file per week via direct-to-Cloudinary browser upload. Old file deleted from Cloudinary before new upload.

features.name: Title editing
features.description: Inline title edit form per week with save button.

features.name: Date picker
features.description: Custom neumorphic calendar picker for setting the lab-performed date per week (admin only).

features.name: Delete week
features.description: Delete a week and all its files (Cloudinary + DB) with confirmation dialog.

features.name: Module status toggle
features.description: Toggle module status between 'ready' and 'soon'.

features.name: Loading spinners
features.description: Inline loading animation on all action buttons (split, upload, docx, delete). Button shows spinner class + rotating circle while processing.

features.name: Toast notifications
features.description: Global toast system for every action success/failure. Auto-dismiss after 3.5s, click to dismiss early. Green for success, red for errors.

features.name: Admin session protection
features.description: Middleware (proxy.ts) protects /admin routes, redirects to login if no valid session.

features.name: Cloudinary PDF delivery fix
features.description: Proxy route for DOCX downloads to get correct filenames. Print-merge route for merged PDFs (Cloudinary free plan blocks PDF delivery).

features.name: Filename parser
features.description: Parses filenames like 'Week1_(print 1,3,5,7 pages)_Title.pdf' to extract week number, print pages, and title.

features.name: Idempotent re-split
features.description: splitWeekCore calls clearPageFiles at the start, making re-split safe against duplicates and concurrent calls.

features.name: Full PDF proxy route
features.description: Proxies full PDF download from Cloudinary with correct Content-Disposition filename (e.g. Week1_Lab_1.pdf instead of report.pdf).

features.name: Page transition loading spinners
features.description: loading.tsx files for route transitions (home, module, admin). Shows spinner during server component data fetching.

features.name: Direct Cloudinary upload
features.description: Browser uploads files directly to Cloudinary using signed URLs (bypasses Next.js 10MB body size limit). Server generates SHA256 signature via /api/admin/cloudinary-sign, client uploads to Cloudinary API, then calls API route to save metadata in Supabase.

features.name: Week links
features.description: Admin can add external links (e.g. GitHub repo) per week. Links show on public cards with target=_blank.

features.name: Navbar
features.description: Sticky blur-backed top navigation bar with logo, page links, and admin button. Responsive: links hidden on mobile.

files.note: No unique constraint on (week_id, kind) — allows re-split without conflicts
